<style id="__sep-inset-8mm">
/* Every separator keeps 8mm of clear page at each edge, whatever its colour: clear to 8mm,
   eased to solid by 16mm, mirrored right. Supersedes the 0px ramps in __fade-tight,
   __fade-edge and __labref-zebra.
   TWO instruments, deliberately: a mask ONLY on the empty rule elements, because mask-image
   also masks an element's descendants — masking a text-bearing row drops its first and last
   glyphs to ~25% alpha. Everything that paints text is restopped via background-image instead,
   with background-size/position preserved so the band geometry is unchanged. */

html body div.page .ap-line,
html body div.page div.footer::before,
html body div.page div.footer::after{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0,rgba(0,0,0,0) 8mm,rgba(0,0,0,.35) 11mm,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 13mm,rgba(0,0,0,1) 16mm,rgba(0,0,0,1) calc(100% - 16mm),rgba(0,0,0,.8) calc(100% - 13mm),rgba(0,0,0,.35) calc(100% - 11mm),rgba(0,0,0,0) calc(100% - 8mm),rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%) !important;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0,rgba(0,0,0,0) 8mm,rgba(0,0,0,.35) 11mm,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 13mm,rgba(0,0,0,1) 16mm,rgba(0,0,0,1) calc(100% - 16mm),rgba(0,0,0,.8) calc(100% - 13mm),rgba(0,0,0,.35) calc(100% - 11mm),rgba(0,0,0,0) calc(100% - 8mm),rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%) !important;-webkit-mask-repeat:no-repeat !important;mask-repeat:no-repeat !important;-webkit-mask-size:100% 100% !important;mask-size:100% 100% !important}
html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.results thead tr,
html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref thead tr{background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(158,172,186,0) 0,rgba(158,172,186,0) 8mm,rgba(158,172,186,.35) 11mm,rgba(158,172,186,.8) 13mm,rgb(158,172,186) 16mm,rgb(158,172,186) calc(100% - 16mm),rgba(158,172,186,.8) calc(100% - 13mm),rgba(158,172,186,.35) calc(100% - 11mm),rgba(158,172,186,0) calc(100% - 8mm),rgba(158,172,186,0) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(158,172,186,0) 0,rgba(158,172,186,0) 8mm,rgba(158,172,186,.35) 11mm,rgba(158,172,186,.8) 13mm,rgb(158,172,186) 16mm,rgb(158,172,186) calc(100% - 16mm),rgba(158,172,186,.8) calc(100% - 13mm),rgba(158,172,186,.35) calc(100% - 11mm),rgba(158,172,186,0) calc(100% - 8mm),rgba(158,172,186,0) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(242,245,249,0) 0,rgba(242,245,249,0) 8mm,rgba(242,245,249,.35) 11mm,rgba(242,245,249,.8) 13mm,rgb(242,245,249) 16mm,rgb(242,245,249) calc(100% - 16mm),rgba(242,245,249,.8) calc(100% - 13mm),rgba(242,245,249,.35) calc(100% - 11mm),rgba(242,245,249,0) calc(100% - 8mm),rgba(242,245,249,0) 100%) !important;background-size:100% 2px,100% 2px,100% calc(100% - 4px) !important;background-position:top left,bottom left,left top 2px !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important}

<style id="__zebra-band-match">
/* Rows 1-8 carry the SAME stripe band as the 9-12 sub-rows, and the Section 03 rows match it:
   zero alpha at both page edges, held clear past the 38.4px margin, then eased in over 92/150px.

<style id="__sig-space">
/* The signature area was 12px tall with the rule at its foot — no room for a handwritten
   signature — while ~70px of auto margin sat empty between the Section 04 separator and
   "Prepared & Approved by". The grid stays bottom-anchored (margin-top:auto), so growing
   .ap-sign consumes that empty margin upward: the role label rises toward the separator and
   the footer clearance is unchanged. Applies to both signature blocks. */

html body div.page div.approval-grid .ap-sign{height:60px !important;margin-bottom:1px !important}

LR:
<style id="__labref-ac-certgrid">
/* Section 03, appended last. Four things:
   1. the laboratory cell is ONE INLINE RUN again: English name · | · Macedonian name ·
      accreditation id · address. It wraps naturally inside the column, so where the English
      runs past one line the Macedonian continues INLINE on row 2 rather than claiming a row
      of its own. This deliberately reverses the .mk{display:block} of __labref-2line.
   2. the accreditation id (LT-0nn (IARM)) is its own span at the end of the Macedonian run,
      so it lands on row 2 with it.
   3. the CoA Doc. Code column widens 180 -> 268px; the laboratory column is auto-width and
      yields the difference (right edge 441.7 -> 353.7px).
   4. certificates flow TWO PER ROW in that column: two inline on row 1, the third starting
      row 2, and so on.
   nowrap is NOT set on the Macedonian name or the address: an unbreakable 212px run in a
   310px column overflows the cell and breaches the margin rather than wrapping. Breaking is
   the safe failure here. */
html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref colgroup col:nth-child(2){width:268px !important}
html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref colgroup col:nth-child(3){width:172px !important}

PRINT:
<style id="__print-opaque">
/* PRINT FIDELITY — appended last, and entirely inside @media print, so the screen design is
   untouched.

   Why this layer exists. The screen design fades every band and rule to ALPHA ZERO at the page
   edges. On paper that is three separate risks: (a) browsers drop background images from print
   unless print-color-adjust is exact, which would erase every band, rule and stripe; (b) an
   alpha gradient and a mask both create a transparency group, which a PDF engine must flatten
   — and flattening at the print raster resolution is what produces banding, grey haloes and
   soft edges; (c) some engines drop mask-image outright, which would print the gold rules
   FULL BLEED and silently destroy the 8mm inset.

   The fix is to composite against white at author time instead of at raster time. Over a white
   sheet, rgba(C,a) is exactly rgb(C mixed toward white by 1-a) — the same pixels, with no
   transparency anywhere. Every stop below was computed from the screen stop, not matched by
   eye, so print and screen are the same design and not two designs.

   Consequence worth knowing: these gradients are OPAQUE WHITE at the edges, not transparent.
   They are therefore correct on white paper only. If the sheet is ever tinted, this layer has
   to be recomputed against the new paper colour. */
@media print{
  @page{size:A4;margin:0}
  html,body{background:#fff !important;padding:0 !important;margin:0 !important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact !important;print-color-adjust:exact !important}
  *,*::before,*::after{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact !important;print-color-adjust:exact !important;mix-blend-mode:normal !important}
  html body div.page{flex:none !important;box-shadow:none !important;margin:0 !important;width:210mm !important;height:297mm !important;overflow:hidden !important}
  /* masks off — replaced by the opaque equivalents below */
  html body div.page div.goldrule,html body div.page .ap-line,html body div.page div.footer::before,html body div.page div.footer::after{-webkit-mask-image:none !important;mask-image:none !important}
  html body div.page div.goldrule{background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(222,209,183) 11mm,rgb(179,150,89) 13mm,rgb(160,124,48) 16mm,rgb(160,124,48) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(179,150,89) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(222,209,183) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%) !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important;background-size:100% 100% !important}
  html body div.page .ap-line{background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(222,209,183) 11mm,rgb(179,150,89) 13mm,rgb(160,124,48) 16mm,rgb(160,124,48) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(179,150,89) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(222,209,183) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%) !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important;background-size:100% 100% !important}
  html body div.page div.selrow::before,html body div.page div.selrow::after{background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(222,209,183) 11mm,rgb(179,150,89) 13mm,rgb(160,124,48) 16mm,rgb(160,124,48) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(179,150,89) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(222,209,183) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%) !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important;background-size:100% 100% !important}
  /* footer rule: the 0.55 opacity is baked into the stops so no transparency group is created */
  html body div.page div.footer::before{opacity:1 !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgb(202,185,157) 0%,rgb(210,196,171) 22%,rgb(203,199,189) 45%,rgb(191,196,202) 65%,rgb(180,192,205) 85%,rgb(169,186,204) 100%) !important}
  html body div.page div.footer::after{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#fdfeff 0%,#fcfeff 55%,#fff 100%) !important}
  /* table header bands: two 2px rules over a fill, all three opaque */
  html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.results thead tr,html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref thead tr{background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(221,226,231) 11mm,rgb(177,189,200) 13mm,rgb(158,172,186) 16mm,rgb(158,172,186) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(177,189,200) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(221,226,231) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(221,226,231) 11mm,rgb(177,189,200) 13mm,rgb(158,172,186) 16mm,rgb(158,172,186) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(177,189,200) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(221,226,231) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(250,252,253) 11mm,rgb(245,247,250) 13mm,rgb(242,245,249) 16mm,rgb(242,245,249) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(245,247,250) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(250,252,253) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%) !important;background-size:100% 2px,100% 2px,100% calc(100% - 4px) !important;background-position:top left,bottom left,left top 2px !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important}
  /* terminal rules */
  html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.results tbody tr.last-row,html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref tbody,html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref tbody tr:last-child{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 8mm,rgb(221,226,231) 11mm,rgb(177,189,200) 13mm,rgb(158,172,186) 16mm,rgb(158,172,186) calc(100% - 16mm),rgb(177,189,200) calc(100% - 13mm),rgb(221,226,231) calc(100% - 11mm),#fff calc(100% - 8mm),#fff 100%) !important;background-size:100% 2px !important;background-position:bottom left !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important}
  /* zebra stripes */
  html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.results tbody tr:not(.row-group):not(.sub-row):not(.last-row):nth-of-type(even),html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref tbody tr:nth-child(even){background-color:transparent !important;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0,#fff 38px,rgb(251,252,253) 92px,rgb(248,249,252) 150px,rgb(247,249,252) 50%,rgb(248,249,252) calc(100% - 150px),rgb(251,252,253) calc(100% - 92px),#fff calc(100% - 38px),#fff 100%) !important;background-size:100% 100% !important;background-position:top left !important;background-repeat:no-repeat !important}
  html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.results tbody tr:not(.row-group):not(.sub-row):not(.last-row):nth-of-type(odd),html body div.page div.tbl-wrap table.labref tbody tr:nth-child(odd){background-image:none !important}
  /* the brand mark is an inline SVG data-URI: keep it vector, never resample */
  html body div.page img.hb-logo{image-rendering:auto !important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact !important;print-color-adjust:exact !important}
}
</style>
LKFIT:
<style id="__lk-shrink-fit">
/* 15 grade-less documents carry the long "Per grade of the potency specification of
   15.09.2026 — no Total THC result on file" string in the Potency cell. The Section 01 rows
   are auto-track grids, so that 408px value starved the Specification Reference track: its
   red [ — ] span rendered 26.5px inside a 16.3px cell and ended 10.2px PAST the right margin.
   The cell box was inside the margin, which is why the box-based margin assertion passed it.

   Fix: let the cells and their values shrink and wrap, so the auto tracks redistribute instead
   of one track overflowing. No font change, no rewording of the register's string, no change
   to the number of columns. */
html body div.page div.gridrow.lk-inline{min-width:0 !important}
html body div.page div.gridrow.lk-inline > .lk{min-width:0 !important}
html body div.page div.gridrow.lk-inline > .lk > .lk-val{min-width:0 !important;white-space:normal !important;overflow-wrap:anywhere !important}
html body div.page div.gridrow.lk-inline > .lk > .lk-val > span{white-space:normal !important;overflow-wrap:anywhere !important}
</style>
